services.title: Purchase Management
services.description: Digitally onboard suppliers, create and approve purchase requisitions, manage RFQs and sourcing, issue POs, track deliveries, match invoices and automate payments — complete P2P lifecycle visibility.

sections.title: Vendor Onboarding & Management
sections.description: Digitally onboard, validate and manage suppliers through a structured registration, KYC, compliance and approval process. Build a centralized and reliable supplier master.

sections.title: Purchase Requisition (PR) Management
sections.description: Create, import, track and approve purchase requisitions with configurable workflows and budget controls. Provide procurement teams complete visibility into demand.
sections.result: Full demand visibility for procurement teams.

sections.title: RFQ & Strategic Sourcing
sections.description: Convert approved requirements into RFQs, invite qualified suppliers, receive quotations and identify the best commercial offer through structured comparison and sourcing.
sections.result: Best commercial offers through structured sourcing.

sections.title: Purchase Order (PO) Management
sections.description: Convert approved requisitions or sourcing awards into purchase orders with controlled approvals, commercial terms and complete order visibility.
sections.result: Controlled POs with full audit trail.

sections.title: Order Confirmation & ASN
sections.description: Collaborate digitally with suppliers after PO release. Capture order acknowledgements and Advance Shipping Notices to improve visibility of upcoming deliveries.
sections.result: Upcoming delivery visibility for all stakeholders.

sections.title: Goods Receipt & Quality Management
sections.description: Track material receipt against purchase orders and perform inspection and quality checks to ensure supplied goods meet quantity and quality requirements.
sections.result: Quality assured receipts with performance tracking.

sections.title: Invoice Management & 3-Way Match
sections.description: Digitize supplier invoice processing and automatically validate invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts before posting for payment.

sections.title: Payments, Analytics & Reporting
sections.description: Track invoice and payment status while providing procurement teams with real-time dashboards for spend, savings, supplier performance and operational KPIs.

services.title: Vendor Management
services.tagline: Complete vendor lifecycle from invitation to archival
services.description: Centralized vendor database with performance tracking — covering self-registration, onboarding, compliance, approvals, categorization, monitoring and exit.

sections.title: Vendor Invitation & Self-Registration
sections.description: Vendors register themselves through a secure portal.
sections.result: Faster onboarding with zero manual data entry.

sections.title: Vendor Profile Creation
sections.description: Vendors maintain accurate and standardized profiles.

sections.title: Document Upload & Compliance Management
sections.description: Ensure statutory and internal compliance from day one.

sections.title: Automated Validation & Risk Checks
sections.description: ATILA performs system-driven validations to reduce risk.

sections.title: Multi-Level Approval Workflow
sections.description: Configurable approval flows ensure governance without delays.

sections.title: Vendor Activation & ERP Sync
sections.description: Once approved, vendors become transaction-ready.
points: Vendor status set to Active / De-active / Block / Blacklist
Eligible for RFQs, POs, and invoices
sections.result: One source of truth for vendor data.

sections.title: Vendor Categorization & Classification
sections.description: Segment vendors strategically.

sections.title: Continuous Compliance Monitoring
sections.description: ATILA ensures compliance is ongoing—not one-time.

sections.title: Vendor Exit & Archival
sections.description: Control vendor suspension or exit with full audit trail.

services.title: O2C - Order to Cash Cycle
services.description: Automate the entire order-to-cash cycle — from customer inquiry through payment collection — to accelerate cash flow, reduce DSO and improve customer satisfaction.

sections.title: Customer Inquiry
sections.description: Capture customer requirements, products, quantities, specifications and expected delivery dates. Convert qualified inquiries into quotations.
points: Multi-channel inquiry capture — web, email, phone
sections.result: No lead falls through the cracks.

sections.title: Customer Onboarding
sections.description: Digitally onboard customers with company details, GST/KYC documents, billing and shipping locations, contacts, payment terms and approval workflows.
points: Payment terms and credit limit setup

sections.title: Quotation & Pricing
sections.description: Create quotations using approved product and customer-specific price lists. Manage discounts, taxes, validity periods and commercial terms.

sections.title: Sales Order Confirmation
sections.description: Convert accepted quotations or customer POs into confirmed sales orders. Validate item, quantity, pricing, delivery terms and approvals before confirmation.

sections.title: Order Scheduling
sections.description: Plan delivery schedules against confirmed orders based on requested dates and availability. Support multiple schedules and partial fulfillment.

sections.title: Dispatch & Delivery
sections.description: Plan dispatch, capture transporter and vehicle details, track dispatched quantities and maintain delivery documentation and POD.

sections.title: Invoice Management
sections.description: Generate invoices against dispatched quantities with applicable taxes and commercial terms, and make invoices available to customers digitally.

sections.title: Payment & Receivables
sections.description: Track invoice due dates, outstanding amounts, partial/full payments and overdue receivables until payment is received and reconciled.
